title: Drifted
description:
Your best friend, Lonnie, has been missing for over a month. The local investigation has made no progress in finding them. Despite being states away, you travel back to your hometown to search their empty house for answers. What you find, however, are paintings that make you shudder and letters that cry for help. You begin to turn to the art for answers, but soon your reality warps around you. The doors are moving, the hallway lights flicker, and you can’t shake this awful feeling of being watched. Is that painting…staring at you?

Drifted is a first-person, mystery/horror game that mixes traditional art with digital 2D and 3D art to paint a mansion of curiosities and clues. Play as Zea, searching for your best friend. Tread carefully, read through the crumpled pages, and don't trust the paintings. 

As the player, use your mouse and keyboard to navigate through the house. Double check your inventory and re-read letters and journal pages for clues. Through the art you discover and the love you hold for them, you will find Lonnie again…won’t you?
description_short: DRIFTED is a 3d horror mystery game, as you explore a mansion looking for your missing friend, you will find many secrets within as you uncover the mystery behind their disappearance. Between locked rooms and fighting monsters, who knows what you will uncover!
